title: चतुस्त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 34 · What the Earth said about brahmins

summary.en: Bhishma tells Yudhishthira to honour the brahmins always, since they are lords of joy and sorrow and like kings of the moon, and that whatever offering feeds them pleases the ancestors and the gods. He tells how Vasudeva asked the Earth, mother of all beings, by what act a householder washes away sin, and she answered that it is by honouring brahmins.
summary.kn: ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ಸದಾ ಗೌರವಿಸಬೇಕು, ಅವರು ಸುಖ-ದುಃಖಗಳ ಒಡೆಯರು, ಚಂದ್ರನ ರಾಜರಂತೆ, ಯಾವ ಹವಿಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಅವರನ್ನು ತೃಪ್ತಿಪಡಿಸಿದರೂ ಪಿತೃ-ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಸಂತೋಷಪಡುತ್ತಾರೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಗೃಹಸ್ಥ ಪಾಪ ಹೇಗೆ ತೊಳೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆಂದು ವಾಸುದೇವ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣರನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಎಂದು ಅವಳು ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿದಳು.
summary.hi: भीष्म कहते हैं कि ब्राह्मणों का सदा सम्मान करना चाहिए क्योंकि वे सुख-दुःख के स्वामी और चन्द्रमा के राजाओं जैसे हैं, और जिस हविष्य से उन्हें तृप्त किया जाए उससे पितर और देवता प्रसन्न होते हैं। वे बताते हैं कि वासुदेव ने सब प्राणियों की माता पृथ्वी से पूछा कि गृहस्थ पाप कैसे धोता है और उसने उत्तर दिया कि ब्राह्मणों के सम्मान से।
summary.te: బ్రాహ్మణులను ఎల్లప్పుడూ గౌరవించాలని, వారు సుఖదుఃఖాల ప్రభువులు, చంద్రుని రాజుల వంటివారని, ఏ హవిస్సుతో వారిని తృప్తిపరిచినా పితృదేవతలు, దేవతలు సంతోషిస్తారని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు. గృహస్థుడు పాపం ఎలా కడుగుతాడని వాసుదేవుడు భూమిని అడిగినప్పుడు బ్రాహ్మణులను గౌరవించడంతో అని ఆమె బదులిచ్చిన కథ చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: அந்தணரை எப்போதும் மதிக்க வேண்டும், அவர்கள் இன்ப துன்பங்களின் தலைவர், நிலவின் மன்னர் போன்றவர், எந்த அவியால் அவர்களை நிறைவு செய்தாலும் முன்னோரும் தேவரும் மகிழ்கின்றனர் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். இல்லறத்தான் பாவத்தை எவ்வாறு கழுவுகிறான் என்று வாசுதேவன் பூமியைக் கேட்க, அந்தணரை மதிப்பதால் என்று அவள் பதிலளித்தாள்.
summary.ml: ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ എപ്പോഴും ആദരിക്കണമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് പറയുന്നു; അവർ സന്തോഷത്തിന്റെയും ദുഃഖത്തിന്റെയും അധിപന്മാരാണ്, ചന്ദ്രനിലെ രാജാക്കന്മാരെപ്പോലെയാണ്. അവരെ ഊട്ടുന്ന ഏതു ബലിയും പിതൃക്കളെയും ദേവന്മാരെയും പ്രീതിപ്പെടുത്തുന്നു. ബ്രാഹ്മണരെ ആദരിക്കുന്നതിലൂടെയാണ് ഗൃഹസ്ഥൻ പാപം കഴുകിക്കളയുന്നതെന്ന് സർവ്വഭൂതങ്ങളുടെയും മാതാവായ ഭൂമി പറഞ്ഞത് വാസുദേവൻ ചോദിച്ചപ്പോഴാണെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.34; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणानेव सततं भृशं संप्रतिपूजयेत् ।
एते हि सोमराजान ईश्वराः सुखदुःखयोः ॥

meaning.en: One should constantly and earnestly honor brahmins alone, for they are the lords of soma and rule over happiness and sorrow.

verses.text:
एते भोगैरलंकारैरन्यैश्चैव किमिच्छकैः ।
सदा पूज्या नमस्कार्या रक्ष्याश्च पितृवन्नृपैः ।
अतो राष्ट्रस्य शान्तिर्हि भूतानामिव वासवात् ॥

meaning.en: Kings should always honor them, bow to them, and protect them like fathers, with enjoyments, ornaments and whatever else they wish for. Through them the kingdom is at peace, as beings are through Indra.

verses.text:
जायतां ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी राष्ट्रे वै ब्राह्मणः शुचिः ।
महारथश्च राजन्य एष्टव्यः शत्रुतापनः ॥

meaning.en: Let a pure brahmin radiant with Vedic power be born in the kingdom, and let a great-chariot kshatriya who torments his foes also be sought.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणं जातिसंपन्नं धर्मज्ञं संशितव्रतम् ।
वासयेत गृहे राजन्न तस्मात्परमस्ति वै ॥

meaning.en: King, one should keep in one's house a brahmin of good birth who knows dharma and keeps sharp vows. There is nothing higher than that.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हविर्दत्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति देवताः ।
पितरः सर्वभूतानां नैतेभ्यो विद्यते परम् ॥

meaning.en: The gods accept the offering given to brahmins, and so do the ancestors of all beings. There is nothing higher than them.

verses.text:
आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा वायुर्भूमिरापोऽम्बरं दिशः ।
सर्वे ब्राह्मणमाविश्य सदान्नमुपभुञ्जते ॥

meaning.en: The sun, moon, wind, earth, waters, sky and the quarters all enter a brahmin and always partake of food through him.

verses.text:
न तस्याश्नन्ति पितरो यस्य विप्रा न भुञ्जते ।
देवाश्चाप्यस्य नाश्नन्ति पापस्य ब्राह्मणद्विषः ॥

meaning.en: The ancestors do not eat what the brahmins of the giver do not eat, and the gods too do not eat the food of a sinner who hates brahmins.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेषु तु तुष्टेषु प्रीयन्ते पितरः सदा ।
तथैव देवता राजन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥

meaning.en: When brahmins are pleased, the ancestors are always pleased, and so are the gods, king. There is no need to doubt it.

verses.text:
तथैव तेऽपि प्रीयन्ते येषां भवति तद्धविः ।
न च प्रेत्य विनश्यन्ति गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: In the same way those for whom the offering was made are pleased, and after death they are not destroyed but go to the highest goal.

verses.text:
येन येनैव हविषा ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयेन्नरः ।
तेन तेनैव प्रीयन्ते पितरो देवतास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: With whatever offering a man satisfies brahmins, the ancestors and gods are pleased with exactly that.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणादेव तद्भूतं प्रभवन्ति यतः प्रजाः ।
यतश्चायं प्रभवति प्रेत्य यत्र च गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: All beings come from a brahmin, from whom creatures arise, and from whom this man comes and to whom he goes after death.

verses.text:
वेदैष मार्गं स्वर्गस्य तथैव नरकस्य च ।
आगतानागते चोभे ब्राह्मणो द्विपदां वरः ।
ब्राह्मणो भरतश्रेष्ठ स्वधर्मं वेद मेधया ॥

meaning.en: The brahmin knows the path to heaven and to hell, and both what has come and what will come. The brahmin is the best of two-footed beings; by his intelligence, best of the Bharatas, he knows his own duty.

verses.text:
ये चैनमनुवर्तन्ते ते न यान्ति पराभवम् ।
न ते प्रेत्य विनश्यन्ति गच्छन्ति न पराभवम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who follow him do not come to defeat. They are not destroyed after death and do not go to ruin.

verses.text:
ये ब्राह्मणमुखात्प्राप्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति वै वचः ।
कृतात्मानो महात्मानस्ते न यान्ति पराभवम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who accept the words that come from a brahmin's mouth, being refined and great-souled, do not meet defeat.

verses.text:
क्षत्रियाणां प्रतपतां तेजसा च बलेन च ।
ब्राह्मणेष्वेव शाम्यन्ति तेजांसि च बलानि च ॥

meaning.en: The brilliance and strength of blazing kshatriyas, both their fire and their power, are quenched only in brahmins.

verses.text:
भृगवोऽजयंस्तालजङ्घान्नीपानङ्गिरसोऽजयन् ।
भरद्वाजो वैतहव्यानैलांश्च भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The Bhrigus defeated the Talajanghas, the Angirases defeated the Nipas, and Bharadvaja defeated the Vitahavyas and the Ailas, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
चित्रायुधांश्चाप्यजयन्नेते कृष्णाजिनध्वजाः ।
प्रक्षिप्याथ च कुम्भान्वै पारगामिनमारभेत् ॥

meaning.en: These wearers of black antelope hide as their banners also defeated the Chitrayudhas. The next clause, about throwing down jars and beginning with one who goes across, is obscure in the text.

verses.text:
यत्किंचित्कथ्यते लोके श्रूयते पश्यतेऽपि वा ।
सर्वं तद्ब्राह्मणेष्वेव गूढोऽग्निरिव दारुषु ॥

meaning.en: Whatever is said, heard or seen in the world is all in brahmins alone, hidden like fire in wood.

verses.text:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
संवादं वासुदेवस्य पृथ्व्याश्च भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: On this point they recall an ancient tale, bull of the Bharatas, a conversation between Vasudeva and the Earth.

verses.text: वासुदेव उवाच

meaning.en: Vasudeva said:

verses.text:
मातरं सर्वभूतानां पृच्छे त्वा संशयं शुभे ।
केन स्वित्कर्मणा पापं व्यपोहति नरो गृही ॥

meaning.en: Auspicious one, mother of all beings, I ask you a doubt: by what action does a householder wash away sin?

verses.text: पृथिव्युवाच

meaning.en: The Earth said:

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणानेव सेवेत पवित्रं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ।
ब्राह्मणान्सेवमानस्य रजः सर्वं प्रणश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Let him serve brahmins alone, for that is the supreme purifier. For one who serves brahmins, all dust of sin is destroyed.

verses.text:
अतो भूतिरतः कीर्तिरतो बुद्धिः प्रजायते ।
अपरेषां परेषां च परेभ्यश्चैव ये परे ॥

meaning.en: From this come prosperity, fame and wisdom, for those of this and other generations, and for those beyond them.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणा यं प्रशंसन्ति पुरुषः स प्रवर्धते ।
अथ यो ब्राह्मणाक्रुष्टः पराभवति सोऽचिरात् ॥

meaning.en: The man whom brahmins praise prospers, while the man reviled by brahmins is soon brought down.

verses.text:
यथा महार्णवे क्षिप्त आमलोष्टो विनश्यति ।
तथा दुश्चरितं कर्म पराभावाय कल्पते ॥

meaning.en: As an unbaked clod thrown into the great ocean dissolves, so evil conduct leads to downfall.

verses.text:
पश्य चन्द्रे कृतं लक्ष्म समुद्रे लवणोदकम् ।
तथा भगसहस्रेण महेन्द्रं परिचिह्नितम् ॥

meaning.en: Look at the mark placed on the moon and the saltiness of the sea. In the same way Indra was marked with a thousand marks of shame.

verses.text:
तेषामेव प्रभावेन सहस्रनयनो ह्यसौ ।
शतक्रतुः समभवत्पश्य माधव यादृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Madhava, see what kind of being he became: through the power of those very brahmins he has a thousand eyes and is the performer of a hundred sacrifices.

verses.text:
इच्छन्भूतिं च कीर्तिं च लोकांश्च मधुसूदन ।
ब्राह्मणानुमते तिष्ठेत्पुरुषः शुचिरात्मवान् ॥

meaning.en: Madhusudana, a pure and self-controlled man who wants prosperity, fame and the worlds should act with the consent of brahmins.

verses.text:
इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मेदिन्या मधुसूदनः ।
साधु साध्वित्यथेत्युक्त्वा मेदिनीं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these words of the Earth, Madhusudana said: Well said, well said, and honored the Earth in return.

verses.text:
एतां श्रुत्वोपमां पार्थ प्रयतो ब्राह्मणर्षभान् ।
सततं पूजयेथास्त्वं ततः श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Son of Pritha, having heard this illustration, you too should be attentive and constantly honor the best of brahmins; then you will gain what is good.
